native_1080_blocker: Current measured allocation layout projects about11.94GB device memory at1920x1080, beyond this8GB GPU; no failing1080 trial was launched.

baseline.overhead_limit: Whole-device measurement includes desktop/other allocations and driver-private state, sampled every1s. The difference is a planning allowance, not measured per-process memory or a guaranteed constant.

allocation_decomposition.mapping: Actual ledger uses device-local memory type1/heap0, HOST_VISIBLE|HOST_COHERENT type2/heap1, readback type3/heap1. This is measured on this RTX5060Laptop, not a universal Vulkan rule.

weather_memory_estimate.method: Use session ledger after optical augmentation. Image allocations were selected by exact size/640x360 and independently checked against actual pixel dispatch writers; two augmented image allocations were confirmed by factory source. Keep scene geometry, textures, BLAS sizes, fixed queue capacity and live capture policy unchanged. Preserve the current alias groups and frames_in_flight=1; only pixel allocations and8B/row reduction scale. No whole-peak times9 shortcut.

source_locations.purpose: 128B/pixel snapshot,4B/pixel marker,8B/height rows; extra cloud queue based on fixed capacity
two80B/pixel histories and color12/debug16 placed HOST by existing selected policy
retained capture resources constrain existing alias reuse; projection retains same selections

conclusions.native1080: Not feasible with the present graph/asset/capture layout: projected heap0 is about11.944GB (11390.6MiB), exceeding the observed available7421251584B by about4313MiB before unreported driver costs.
conclusions.most_likely_common_delivery_resolution: 1280x720 is the highest evaluated common16:9 resolution plausibly fitting: ledger6438MiB,639.5MiB ledger headroom; adding the current observed480.6MiB discrepancy gives about6918.6MiB. This is narrow and not an allocation/render guarantee.
conclusions.conservative_choice: 1024x576: ledger5011.6MiB, roughly2065.9MiB ledger headroom; much safer if avoiding another allocation failure is more important than720p.
conclusions.not_a_saving_to_repeat: Both HOST options are already active. They must not be counted a second time as new1080 savings.
conclusions.capture_retention: Readback staging is heap1, not deviceheap0. Capturing fewer stages may allow some image buffers to alias again, but removing file output alone does not reclaim the multi-GiB1080 deficit; no hypothetical alias savings are claimed.
conclusions.frames: Current frames_in_flight=1; four or more sequential frames do not multiply these persistent GPU buffers by frame_count. CPU OIDN/output storage is separate.
conclusions.preparation_mode: No supported --prepare/--dry-run/--preflight/--plan-only entry was found in current core argument declarations. No renderer process was launched merely to estimate memory.

chosen_by_parent.reason: Use1152x648 to retain more budget margin. Do not launch1080; do not test1280 against the narrow remaining margin. This is a planning choice, not a completed GPU result.

native_visual_review.scope: Native 1152x648 representative still, visual review only; no new rendering, OIDN, or image normalization.

comparison.coverage_and_cost_source: Parent's completed-run measurements; not remeasured in this visual review.

observations.fine_texture: A modest local gain is visible in the far-left door panel moldings, adjacent wall and sidewalk joints. Guided areas retain these lines a little more clearly than the color-only fallback. The road, broad right facade and distant ornament still have substantial denoiser softness; this is not a full-frame fine-detail recovery.
observations.darks: The dark left doorway remains dark but its panel structure is readable. The deep right entrance remains dark in both versions. No obvious new black crush or local brightness discontinuity was visible; hidden detail recovery is not established.
observations.seams: No obvious hard tile seam, straight brightness step, or halo is visible where guide weight fades into the fallback, including the left support and small right-edge support. This is a visual observation from one frame, not a numerical boundary proof.
observations.rain: Rain lines are faint and difficult to identify confidently in this single still. There is no conspicuous new white-fleck layer. This image cannot establish moving-rain visibility or temporal stability.
observations.water_and_scene_edges: The puddle reflection, curb, posts, window frames and red trim remain recognizable. The puddle outline and softened road texture remain existing limitations; unchanged fallback regions must not be credited to guided filtering.
observations.new_artifacts: No obvious new speckle, invented repeated texture, double contour, or local edge break was visible in the inspected still. Fine texture fidelity cannot be certified without a suitable reference.

native_visual_review.decision: Keep as an available, limited-support native-resolution candidate. The modest local guide benefit is retained without an obvious seam in this frame.
limits: Only 14.3176% of this frame has guide support; the remainder uses the color-only fallback.
This is one native still, not a matched 640-versus-1152 quality experiment.
No motion, long disocclusion, rain continuity, or real-time claim follows from this review.
The subsequent motion sequence was not inspected as part of this task.
native_visual_review.writes: Only this C-workspace review JSON; source assets and D/E outputs were not modified.

sequence_visual_review.scope: Read-only visual inspection of all 24 completed exported frames through six native-resolution contact rows; no new rendering, OIDN, metrics, or algorithm changes.

observations.moving_edges: Door and window frames, red trim, posts and curb remain coherent as the camera advances. No conspicuous doubled contour, long trailing silhouette, or tile-shaped discontinuity is visible across the inspected frames.
observations.fine_texture_and_frame_variation: Distant facade/window detail and the left shop-window texture visibly alternate between softer and more articulated appearances, including within frames 4-7 and 12-19. Road and pavement remain broadly smooth. The sequence therefore cannot be described as free of texture variation or flicker; these contact rows do not separate sampling changes, dolly parallax and denoiser response.
observations.water: The puddle retains a recognizable dark reflection and a bounded outline throughout. Small reflected details vary between frames, but no obvious detached wake, duplicated puddle boundary or long smear was seen. This is not proof of accurate reflected motion or water temporal stability.
observations.rain: Rain remains sparse and faint at native 640x360. Occasional thin marks are visible, but a convincing continuous rain trajectory cannot be established from the contact rows. There is no conspicuous bright white-fleck curtain.
observations.darks_and_seams: Dark doorways remain dark without an obvious whole-frame brightness jump. No obvious guide/fallback seam was seen, but guide support is extremely small in this sequence.

sequence_visual_review.conclusion: Keep as a completed short-sequence demonstration of the current export combination, with remaining fine-detail variation and weak rain visibility disclosed. Do not mark it as temporally stable or dynamically clean.
limits: The common valid mask leaves only 0.1667% guided support per frame; almost all output uses current-frame color-only fallback. The native static frame's 14.3176% coverage and local guide benefit must not be attributed to this sequence.
Twenty-four contact images covering 0.383333 seconds are not a playback assessment or proof of long-term temporal stability, disocclusion safety, or cloud evolution.
No matched baseline comparison or new quantitative flicker analysis was performed in this task.
The 1/60-second simulation step is not rendering FPS; the measured GPU mean is about 4.28 seconds per frame.

post_oidn_temporal.comparison: 同一当帧 guide 空间结果：current.png 无历史；output.png 为有限三帧历史。未用旧整批固定屏幕交集输出归因。
post_oidn_temporal.viewing: 原尺寸实际 PNG 与原生 ROI 双行接触图；上 current，下 finite。没有新增图片、OIDN、GPU 或算法修改。

observations.net_gain: 净改善较轻微。路面与部分墙面的细碎起伏略平顺；原尺寸全图中两列大部分区域仍很接近，没有清楚的细节恢复。
observations.moving_edges: f16–19、20–23 的黑栏柱、右侧立柱、窗框和红色檐口未见明显新增双轮廓或长拖影；移动揭露处未见可辨的旧颜色带。
observations.windows_shop: 远处窗格与左店面主要结构保留，未见明显新假纹。原有细纹理软化、局部逐帧软硬变化仍存在，候选没有将这些问题消除。
observations.foreground: 近景铺装与道路略更平滑，部分低对比起伏也略变软；主要砖缝和路缘线仍保留，未见明显新的结构断裂。
observations.coverage_transitions: 重点看了 f16→17 与 f21→22。未见对应覆盖下降的明显硬接缝、局部亮度跳阶或整块闪变；这一判断限于原生接触图和选定完整帧，不能证明播放时完全无闪烁。
observations.protected_regions: 选定全帧中水洼轮廓、玻璃区域和稀疏雨线未见明显新变化。雨很弱，静态接触图不足以评价雨的完整运动连续性。

decision.reason: 未发现明显可见回归，有限局部平顺收益足以作为离线推荐中的可选短历史处理保留，并保留无历史控制；收益不足以宣称动态细节已修复或据此替换唯一默认。

supporting_metrics.usage: 仅作支持：既有几何匹配差异指标下降且空间梯度略降，与平顺及少量软化的目视趋势相符；未用指标直接批准。

limits: 24 帧仅覆盖约 0.383333 秒、约 0.821429 米 dolly；未覆盖更长时域、快速运动或复杂失遮挡。
接触图不是实时播放或时域稳定性证明；没有宣称无闪烁。
这是现有渲染数据的 CPU 离线候选，未证明实时成本或 GPU 集成效果。
